name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Efficiency
summary: A Muramite trial arena designed to test speed, precision, and resource efficiency under Discord‑charged constraints.
description: The Trial of Efficiency challenges combatants to complete objectives with minimal wasted motion, energy, or time. Muramite overseers monitor every action, scoring participants on precision and optimization. The arena contains shifting obstacles, timed mechanisms, and Discord pylons that drain stamina. Dragorn captives are forced to perform tasks under extreme pressure, while Muramite soldiers prove their mastery of efficient combat. Discord constructs and anomalies appear when efficiency falters, punishing hesitation.
